(A) Random word replacement (5%, 10%, 20%) as lower-bound. Critical confound control flagged by dream (all three tiers). Low cost, high impact on paper credibility.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan_014\", \"claim\": 1, \"name\": \"large_scale_generator\", \"description\": \"Add one 7B+ generator (Qwen3-8B-Base or similar) to test whether depth signal persists at frontier scale. 1000 seeds × 5 depths. Addresses RC9: all current generators ≤2.8B. RTX 5090 (32GB) can run 8B model at FP16 (~16GB weights).\\n\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 8, \"deps\": [\"plan_002\"], \"notes\": \"Dream review flagged ≤2.8B as major limitation (all three tiers). If depth signal weaker at scale → honest limitation with analysis. If comparable → strong generalization evidence for the paper.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan_015\", \"claim\": 1, \"name\": \"ordinal_baseline_comparison\", \"description\": \"CRITICAL missing baseline (flagged by both re-dreams, all three tiers): Test whether existing detector continuous scores already provide ordinal depth signal. Regress FastDetectGPT, Binoculars, and LD-Score continuous scores on generation depth. Compare single-feature ordinal classifiers (each detector score as sole feature) vs our 7-feature model. If existing detectors yield comparable ordinal signal, our custom feature set contribution collapses.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 3, \"deps\": [\"plan_002\"], \"notes\": \"Re-dream consensus: without this comparison, reviewers will question whether depth-specific features add value. If any single detector achieves >0.70 ordinal F1, we need to reframe our contribution as \\\"complementary to existing detectors\\\" not \\\"novel approach.\\\"\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}], \"total\": 15}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}
